domestic_evidence: Company website (dragarwal.com/about-us) states: "325+ Eye Hospitals", "800+ Experienced Ophthalmologists", "2L+ Surgeries Every Year", "operating in 14 states and 4 Union Territories" in India, plus "presence in Africa, serving patients across nine countries: Ghana, Uganda, Kenya, Madagascar, Tanzania, Rwanda, Zambia, Mozambique and Mauritius". This is an operating hospital network with in-India service delivery (14 states + 4 UTs) and a listed corporate entity "Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Ltd" with an investor section. Note: this is a healthcare-services footprint, not a goods-supply contract; no GST turnover figure, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report revenue split could be retrieved — web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) on all attempts, so revenue and domestic turnover are recorded as null rather than estimated.
note: Real, dated export shipments are confirmed by Indian customs records, not by website claims: 390 shipment records, latest 2026-02-28, Chennai Air Cargo -> Lusaka/Zambia, with HS codes and B/L 1126951 visible. Destinations across five African buyers (Zambia, Mozambique, Ghana, Madagascar, Rwanda) match the company's stated Africa footprint. IMPORTANT HS MISMATCH: declared HS 847150 (ADP machines / IT-electronics) does not match the actual shipped goods, which are ophthalmic surgical consumables and devices — HS 90185090 (ophthalmic instruments/appliances), 90189023 (other surgical instruments), 30049087 (medicaments, ophthalmic preparations). Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base, the actual HS codes are recorded (90185090 / 90189023 / 30049087), and the verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. The claimed industry 'IT и электроника' is likewise incorrect — actual activity is eye-care hospital network plus export of ophthalmic consumables. Revenue and export value: null — not public in the free views, not invented. Domestic side: in-India operations confirmed by the company's own network description (14 states, 4 UTs, 325+ hospitals); no GST turnover band or public-procurement contract record was retrievable because web_search failed throughout, so domestic turnover is null. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were examined (out of scope for this role).
